name: Kora Highlands
desc: Upland farming communities supply grain to the central and coastal markets. Seasonal roads limit access.

name: Sava Plains
desc: The largest farming region. Storage losses and unreliable irrigation put household incomes under pressure.

name: Westmere
desc: Manufacturing towns connect western farms with the national logistics corridor.

name: Central District
desc: The capital, Ayara, depends on incoming food shipments. A damaged bridge has increased freight costs.

name: Eastbank
desc: River settlements depend on fishing, ferries and flood-sensitive roads. Cold storage is scarce.

name: Azure Coast
desc: A dense coastal economy imports fuel and moves food through its port. Low-income residents face high food bills.
